title: How BJP is Destroying Delhi
description:
BJP finally took over the Delhi government after a decade of AAP rule. But has anything really changed for the people? From flashy announcements to shallow execution, the cracks are already showing.

Rising water bills, crumbling public transport, and unclear policies—while the PR is loud, the groundwork feels missing. Add to that the Centre-state coordination drama, and Delhiites are stuck in yet another blame game.

In this video, we break down what’s going wrong under BJP’s new rule in Delhi—and why a political win doesn’t always mean a governance win.
